g.text: Same, requiring ≥1 percentage point at both ends
Does the parameter ranking settle down?
Current policy success, trailing 20 minutes · fixed cohort: 10 configurations / 14 training runs · no historical peaks
Turnover compares every pair of configurations with its order 30 minutes earlier (45 pairs total). Lower means less reshuffling.
Gray shows raw measurement sensitivity. Orange excludes close calls; 1 percentage point is a practical display threshold, not a significance test.
Seeds are averaged within each configuration; missing/OOM/short runs stay outside this fixed-cohort ranking. Validation timing limits temporal precision.
